description: This file contains C++ unit tests for the Telemetry module using Google Test and Google Mock. It tests various methods like uploadReport, setReportProfileStatus, logApplicationEvent, and abortReport via mock interfaces, event handling, and verifying responses and event triggers. The tests include setup/teardown, mock expectations, and simulation of system events and external API calls.
